title: Murder Drones Extras
description: This resourcepack adds a lot of small Murder Drone models to a few items and blocks in the game
body:
THis adds the following:
Iron Ingot Changes
- Custom Model Data 1 - Cyn
- Custom Model Data 2 - V
- Custom Model Data 3 - N
- Custom Model Data 4 - Uzi

Shield
- Turns into Cyn's Solver

Flower Pots
- Cornflower turns into V's Totally Suspecious Flag

Totem of Undying (Will be changed soon)
- Cyn with Emmisive Textures (Hopefully)
